tools.name: ask
tools.description: START HERE. Answers a fan question in Chinese/Japanese/English in one call: parses terms (音番, 見面會/ミーグリ 第N部, ブログ/部落格, N單 C位/站位, 周邊/グッズ 有貨嗎, 行程/下週/下個月, 新聞), member names/nicknames and dates (JST), then calls the right tool(s). Returns interpreted_as + confidence; if ambiguous returns candidates and calls nothing. Not for: exact ids you already have (call the specific tool). e.g. "下週有什麼音番", "16單 C位是誰".

query.description: The fan question as written, e.g. "京都見面會第3部幾點", "石森璃花 最新blog", "這週行程".

date_range.description: Optional explicit JST date range overriding dates in the query.

before.description: Continue a past-history search: only months BEFORE this YYYY-MM (exclusive). Use the value from a previous result's next hint (continue_before) when it was truncated_by_deadline.

raw.description: Also return raw upstream responses (url, http_status, fetched_at, sha256, body) for every request this call made.

max_images.description: How many product pictures to attach as MCP image content (0 = none). Image URLs stay in the JSON either way. Capped at ~1.5 MB total; skipped ones are listed in images_skipped. Off server-wide with SKZ46_DISABLE_IMAGES=1.

tools.name: list_news
tools.description: Use for: official news (新聞/ニュース/公告) by month or category. Default 20 short items (no body; content_excerpt); include_content:true for full HTML, limit<=200, offset paging, byte cap -> truncated+next. Not for: blog posts or the TV/radio schedule. e.g. "10月有什麼新聞", "グッズのお知らせ".

dy.description: YYYY, YYYYMM or YYYYMMDD. Omit for all news.

limit.description: Items to return (default 20, max 200; upstream returns at most 200 per request).

include_content.description: Include the full article HTML body as content (default false since v0.4.2: without it, content is omitted and content_excerpt (plain text, ~120 chars) is given).

max_bytes.description: Byte cap for the JSON items (default 600000, env SKZ46_MAX_RESPONSE_BYTES). Whole items are dropped from the end when exceeded (truncated:true + next hint). The raw:true upstream body is never cut.

raw.description: Also return raw upstream responses (url, http_status, fetched_at, sha256, body) for every request this call made.

tools.name: list_blog_posts
tools.description: Use for: latest member blog posts (ブログ/部落格) list, optionally one member (member name/alias ok). Not for: the blog text (use get_blog_post). e.g. "石森璃花 最新blog".

member.description: Member name or alias instead of member_id, e.g. "石森璃花", "りか", "Rika Ishimori" (resolved like resolve_member; ambiguous names are an error).

raw.description: Also return raw upstream responses (url, http_status, fetched_at, sha256, body) for every request this call made.

tools.name: list_meet_greet_events
tools.description: Use for: list of MEET&GREET / 見面會 / ミーグリ / 握手 events (codes). Not for: session times (then call get_meet_greet_event). e.g. "16單見面會有哪些".

raw.description: Also return raw upstream responses (url, http_status, fetched_at, sha256, body) for every request this call made.

tools.name: list_greeting_cards
tools.description: Use for: member greeting card images (問候卡/グリーティングカード). Not for: profiles. e.g. "璃花的問候卡".

member.description: Member name or alias instead of member_id.

raw.description: Also return raw upstream responses (url, http_status, fetched_at, sha256, body) for every request this call made.

tools.name: get_meet_greet_event
tools.description: Use for: one meet&greet page: dates, venues, 第N部 start/end/受付 times, members. Not for: discovering events. e.g. "京都 第3部幾點" after finding the code.

max_chars.description: Cap for body_text (default 20000 chars); body_truncated:true + body_length when cut.

raw.description: Also return raw upstream responses (url, http_status, fetched_at, sha256, body) for every request this call made.

tools.name: get_schedule
tools.description: Use for: official schedule (行程/スケジュール): TV, radio, magazines, events, birthdays; filters date/month/label/member/genre:"music_tv" (音番). Not for: news articles. e.g. "今天的行程", "11月 音番".

date.description: YYYY-MM-DD: only events on this day.

month.description: YYYY-MM. Default: the current month (site default).

category.description: Category code, e.g. media, event, release, shakehands, birthday (observed values).

label.description: Exact category_label as shown on the site, e.g. テレビ, ラジオ, 雑誌, 配信, WEBメディア, 新聞, ライブ, イベント, 誕生日.

member.description: Only events listing this member (id, name, kana, romaji or alias).

keyword.description: Case-insensitive substring of title or description.

genre.description: Heuristic: music_tv = TV items whose title matches a music-program keyword list (core shows only: Mステ/CDTV/うたコン/THE TIME,/ベストアーティスト/FNS歌謡祭/Venue101/THE MUSIC DAY/紅白...). Results carry genre_match:"heuristic".

raw.description: Also return raw upstream responses (url, http_status, fetched_at, sha256, body) for every request this call made.

tools.name: get_formation
tools.description: Use for: formation (站位/選拔/フォーメーション) of single N or album; center only if official evidence (infer_center opt-in). Not for: track lists. e.g. "16單站位".

list.description: Return a summary of every single/album (no rows).

infer_center.description: Opt-in: when no official center evidence exists, infer center from the middle of an odd-sized front row (center_source front_row_middle, confidence medium). Off by default.

raw.description: Also return raw upstream responses (url, http_status, fetched_at, sha256, body) for every request this call made.

tools.name: get_blog_post
tools.description: Use for: full text + images of one blog post by id (from list_blog_posts). Not for: finding posts. e.g. "read blog 71404".

max_chars.description: Cap for body_text (default 20000 chars); body_truncated:true + body_length when cut.

raw.description: Also return raw upstream responses (url, http_status, fetched_at, sha256, body) for every request this call made.

tools.name: list_discography
tools.description: Use for: all releases (code, title, type, date). Not for: track lists (use get_discography). e.g. "出過哪些專輯".

raw.description: Also return raw upstream responses (url, http_status, fetched_at, sha256, body) for every request this call made.

tools.name: get_discography
tools.description: Use for: one release by code: tracks, editions, price (Sony Music data opt-in). Not for: formation. e.g. "SRCL-13890 曲目".

include_sonymusic.description: Opt-in third-party call to sonymusic.co.jp for track list, price and bonuses. Off by default.

raw.description: Also return raw upstream responses (url, http_status, fetched_at, sha256, body) for every request this call made.

tools.name: list_special_pages
tools.description: Use for: discovering official special pages (live/tour/anniversary sites, 演唱會/ライブ). Not for: the schedule. e.g. "有哪些演唱會特設頁".

raw.description: Also return raw upstream responses (url, http_status, fetched_at, sha256, body) for every request this call made.

tools.name: get_special_page
tools.description: Use for: text/images/links/videos of one special page by slug. Not for: discovery. e.g. "backslive_16th 頁內容".

max_chars.description: Cap for text (default 20000 chars); truncated:true + text_length when cut.

raw.description: Also return raw upstream responses (url, http_status, fetched_at, sha256, body) for every request this call made.

tools.name: list_store_categories
tools.description: Use for: official goods store (周邊/グッズ) category list. Not for: products. e.g. "商店有哪些分類".

raw.description: Also return raw upstream responses (url, http_status, fetched_at, sha256, body) for every request this call made.

tools.name: list_store_products
tools.description: Use for: searching/browsing store products (周邊/グッズ) by keyword/category/page. Not for: stock depth. e.g. "タオル 周邊".

category_id.description: Store category id, e.g. "2024" (【通常配送】ALL ITEMS).

page.description: Page number (default 1). Pages after 1 use the store's POST paging form.

raw.description: Also return raw upstream responses (url, http_status, fetched_at, sha256, body) for every request this call made.

max_images.description: How many product pictures to attach as MCP image content (0 = none). Image URLs stay in the JSON either way. Capped at ~1.5 MB total; skipped ones are listed in images_skipped. Off server-wide with SKZ46_DISABLE_IMAGES=1.

tools.name: get_store_product
tools.description: Use for: one store product: price, variations, public in_stock/SOLD OUT. Not for: stock counts. e.g. "product 12345 有貨嗎".

raw.description: Also return raw upstream responses (url, http_status, fetched_at, sha256, body) for every request this call made.

max_images.description: How many product pictures to attach as MCP image content (0 = none). Image URLs stay in the JSON either way. Capped at ~1.5 MB total; skipped ones are listed in images_skipped. Off server-wide with SKZ46_DISABLE_IMAGES=1.

tools.name: check_store_stock
tools.description: Use for: "還剩多少/快賣完了嗎" via a temporary guest cart on the live store: tries 50; stock_level plenty (>=50) vs low (exactly N left) vs sold_out. Always emptied and verified (cart_cleanup ok/failed); no checkout. Not for: plain in-stock yes/no (get_store_product has it). e.g. "還剩很多嗎".

classcategory_id1.description: Variation id (from get_store_product variations[].classcategory_id1). Required when the product has variations.

classcategory_id2.description: Second-level variation id when the product has one.

probe_quantity.description: Quantity to try (default 50, the per-order cap). The store cuts it to the remaining stock when stock is lower, which gives the exact count. Smaller values only answer "at least that many".

raw.description: Also return raw upstream responses (url, http_status, fetched_at, sha256, body) for every request this call made.

tools.name: resolve_member
tools.description: Use for: member name/kana/romaji/nickname/zh spelling -> member_id, or "all". Not for: blog/schedule (those accept member names directly). e.g. "谷口爱季 是誰".

query.description: e.g. "森田ひかる", "ひかる", "Hikaru Morita", "山崎天", "谷口爱季", or "all" to list every member.

raw.description: Also return raw upstream responses (url, http_status, fetched_at, sha256, body) for every request this call made.
